name: choice
title: Choice
description: One question, several answers, five presentations. Renders as buttons, cards, a list, a wheel or an overlay from the same component and the same state machine. Reports what the player picked and committed; never decides whether it was right. Pass the settled outcome back as `result` and it renders correct, wrong or rewarded with a fill, a glyph and a text change so the answer survives colour blindness, mute and reduced motion.
docs: Use presentation="buttons" for a quiz grid, "cards" for a picker, "list" for long text answers, "wheel" for a spinner and "overlay" for a choice over a live scene. Set commitOnSelect for fast rounds; leave it off when the player should be able to change their mind. Give it an `elementId` and it wires itself to the host adapter: selects and commits reach `track` and `submit`, and settled outcomes arrive through `subscribeForResults` with no `result` prop at all. Leave the id off and it behaves exactly as before, with the host driving `result`.
